author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
The vegetable harvest is in full swing, and it's the perfect time to preserve the season’s freshest flavors for winter 🌶🥦🫜 In this video, we gather garden-fresh vegetables and prepare a colorful homemade pickled mixed salad using traditional village methods.

Crisp peppers, cabbage, carrots, cucumbers, and other seasonal vegetables are carefully sliced, seasoned, and preserved to create a tangy, crunchy salad that’s ready to enjoy throughout the colder months. Every jar captures the freshness, color, and flavor of the summer harvest.

This is authentic village food preservation — fresh garden vegetables, simple ingredients, and time-honored techniques passed down through generations. A delicious and practical way to stock the pantry and enjoy the taste of summer all winter long. 🌿🥒🍅
title: Vegetable Season in the Village | Homemade Pickled Mixed Salad for Winter 🌶🥦🫜
